public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Stardust Solutions is a Series A climate and energy technology company that has raised $75M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private peers in the climate and energy sector, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

The stage-progression method is applicable here and forms the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised of $75M as a proxy for post-money valuation at Series A entry, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $150M. The peer-median approach is not applicable: while nine same-sector peers exist, none meet the filtering thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables needed to derive a robust median (minimum three datapoints required). Relying on an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise and is therefore excluded.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $128M to $172M, with a median of $150M. Given reliance on a single method, key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.0x step-up multiplier for this specific company and the tightness of comparable data at this stage. Validation would benefit from additional same-stage private transaction data or forward-looking metrics specific to Stardust's market position and capital efficiency.
